commands.label: Equalize split sizes
commands.description: Gives every split of the editor area the same width.
examples: SPC w = → the two splits are equally wide again
commands.rationale: Vim uses <C-w>= to give the windows the same size.

intellij.note: No IntelliJ action gives all splits the same size.

commands.label: Focus split left
commands.description: Moves the focus to the split on the left.
examples: SPC w h → the cursor is in the left split
commands.rationale: VSpaceCode, Doom Emacs and LazyVim use SPC w h, after Vim <C-w>h.

semantics.ideavim: IdeaVim runs <C-w>h, which takes a count.

commands.label: Close other splits
commands.description: Closes every split except the one with the cursor.
examples: SPC w o → one split is left
commands.rationale: VSpaceCode and Doom Emacs use SPC w o, after Vim <C-w>o.

semantics.vscodevim: VSCodeVim runs <C-w>o, which closes the other editor groups.
